oromo: Iraan biyyoonni sagantaa qoqqobbii Ameerikaa deeggaran kan biyyattii ta'uu ibsuun, boba'aan Hormuz irra akka hin darbine sodaachisaa jirti; gama biraatiin ammoo Donald Trump naannicha kan Ameerikaati jedhee falmuu isaa ibsameera. Preezidaantichi Faransaay Emmanuel Macron mooticha kuta biyya Sa'udii Mohammed bin Salman waliin marii akka taasisan eegamaa jira. Hamas karoora nagaa Ameerikaan Gizaaf qopheessite, hanga Israa'el fedhii ishee ibsitutti akka hin fudhanne beeksiseera. Kana malees, lakkoofsi buufataalee Israa'el kan gammoojjii Weest Baank keessa jiran 592 ga'uu fi rakkooleen fi miidhaan Paalastayinoota irra gahuu itti fufuu isaa gabaafameera.

title: Israeli forces close only entrance to West Bank village, report says
english: Israeli military forces have blocked the only remaining access point to the West Bank village of Al-Mughayyir, leaving residents trapped. Reports indicate that soldiers used tear gas against commuters and detained several individuals for questioning. This closure follows a previous decision to shut off the village's eastern entrance last year, effectively isolating the community.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በምዕራብ ባንክ አል-ሙጋይር መንደር የነበረውን ብቸኛ መግቢያ በመዝጋታቸው ነዋሪዎቹ እንዳይወጡና እንዳይገቡ ተከልክለዋል። ወታደሮቹ አካባቢውን ለማቋረጥ በሞከሩ ሰዎች ላይ የለቅሶ ጭስ የተኮሱ ሲሆን አንዳንድ ሰዎችንም በጥያቄ መልክ አስረው አጉላላዋል። ባለፈው ዓመት የመንደሩን ምሥራቃዊ መግቢያ ከዘጉ በኋላ፣ አሁን ደግሞ ምዕራባዊውን በመዝጋታቸው መንደሩ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ተገልሏል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el ganda Al-Mugayyir kan naannoo Lixaa Baankii jirtu keessatti balbala ittiin seenan tokko qofa cufuun jiraattootni akka hin baane ykn hin seenne godhaniiru. Waraanni sun namoota karaa sana darbuuf yaalan irratti gaazii imimmaansuu darbachuun, akkasumas namoota muraasa to'annoo jala oolchuun gaaffii fi deebii gaggeessaniiru. Kanaan dura bara darbe balbala gama bahaa erga cufanii booda, amma balbala gama lixaa cufuun isaanii ganda kana guutummaatti addaan citee akka turu taasiseera.

title: Ex-Colombian president: Restoring Israeli ties applauds Gaza genocide
english: Former Colombian President Gustavo Petro has criticized the current government's decision to resume diplomatic relations with Israel. Petro argued that re-establishing these ties while Benjamin Netanyahu remains in power is equivalent to supporting the ongoing violence in Gaza. This move reverses the diplomatic break initiated by Petro two years ago.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኮሎምቢያ ፕሬዝዳንት ጉስታቮ ፔትሮ የአሁኑ መንግስት ከእስራኤል ጋር የነበረውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እንደገና ለመጀመር የወሰደውን እርምጃ ተችተዋል። ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ስልጣን ላይ ባሉበት ወቅት ይህንን ግንኙነት ማደስ በጋዛ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን ጭፍጨፋ እንደ መደገፍ ይቆጠራል ሲሉ ፔትሮ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከሁለት ዓመት በፊት ፔትሮ ከእስራኤል ጋር የነበረውን ግንኙነት እንዲቋረጥ ያደረጉትን ውሳኔ የሚቀለብስ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kolombiyaa duraanii Gustaavo Peetroo mootummaan amma jiru hariiroo diippilomaasii Israa'el wajjin deebisee jalqabuuf murteesse mormaniiru. Peetroon, Binyaamiin Netaaniyaahuun aangoo irra jiranitti hariiroo kana deebisuun sanyii balleessaa Gaazaatti raawwatamu deeggaruu dha jechuun dubbataniiru. Murteen kun waggaa lama dura Pirezidaanti Peetroon hariiroo Israa'el wajjin ture kutuuf fudhatanii turan kan haqu dha.

title: Iranian hackers shut down UK power plant for four days, The Telegraph reports
english: A small power facility in the United Kingdom was forced to shut down for four days following a major cyber attack linked to Iranian hackers. While this incident did not disrupt the national energy supply, the government issued security guidance to utility leaders as a precaution. This event occurred alongside similar digital attacks targeting water infrastructure across the United States.
amharic: ኢራናዊያን ሃከሮች በእንግሊዝ የሚገኝ አንድ ትንሽ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ ለአራት ቀናት እንዲዘጋ አድርገዋል። ጥቃቱ የሀገሪቱን የኃይል አቅርቦት ባያስተጓጉልም፣ መንግስት ለኃይል ኩባንያዎች የደህንነት ምክረ ሃሳቦችን ሰጥቷል። ይህ ድርጊት በአሜሪካ የውሃ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ከተፈጸሙ ተመሳሳይ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች ጋር ተያይዞ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Hakkaronni biyya Iraan bu'uuraalee misooma elektirikii gurguddaa hin taane kan biyya Ingiliz keessa jiru tokko guyyaa afuriif akka cufamu godhaniiru. Hojiin kun dhiibbaa inni biyyattii irratti geesise yoo jiraatuu baatees, mootummaan dhaabbilee humna elektirikiiuf gorsa nageenyaa kenneera. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo addunyaan biyyoota Ameerikaa keessatti miidhaa wal-fakkaataa irratti xiyyeeffachaa turte keessaatti.

title: Hussein al-Sheikh: Decision to hold Palestinian elections in November stands
english: Palestinian official Hussein al-Sheikh has confirmed that plans for legislative elections this November remain unchanged, though Hamas is excluded from participating due to disarmament requirements. If Israeli obstacles prevent the vote, leadership intends to shift focus toward Palestinian National Council elections instead. The government is actively seeking cooperation from the U.S. and Israel to ensure the process includes all Palestinian territories, including the West Bank, Gaza, and Jerusalem.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ሁሴን አል-ሼክ በህዳር ወር የታቀደው ምርጫ እንደማይቀየር አረጋግጠዋል። የጋዛን ትጥቅ የመፍታት ስምምነትን ባለመፈጸሟ ምክንያት ሀማስ በምርጫው እንዳይሳተፍ የተወሰነ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤል ምርጫውን ካደናቀፈች አማራጭ የፍልስጤም ብሔራዊ ምክር ቤት ምርጫ እንደሚካሄድ ተገልጿል። የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት በምዕራብ ባንክ፣ በጋዛ እና በኢየሩሳሌም ምርጫውን ለማካሄድ ከአሜሪካ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር እየተወያዩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan Paalastinii Huseen al-Sheek akka jedhanitti, filannoon ji'a Sadaasaa keessa godhamuuf karoorfame kan hin jijjiiramne ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru. Haata'u malee, dhaabbatni Hamaas meeshaa hiikkachuu dideera jedhamee filannicha irratti akka hirmaatu hin hayyamamu. Yoo gufuun Israa'el mudate, mootummaan filannoo Mana Maree Biyyooleessa Paalastinii gaggeessuuf karoorfateera. Mootummaan Paalastinii naannolee hundatti, kanneen akka Weest Baank, Gaazaa fi Yerusaalemitti filannicha gaggeessuuf biyyoota garaagaraa wajjin mari'achaa jira.

title: ‘You just can’t trust Trump’: Canadian premiers fire back in trade war
english: Canadian provincial leaders have expressed strong distrust toward US President Donald Trump following his decision to place a 50 percent tariff on billions of dollars in Canadian imports. In response to these economic measures, Prime Minister Mark Carney has announced that Canada intends to retaliate with equivalent tariffs. This growing trade conflict marks a significant escalation in tensions between the two neighboring nations.
amharic: የካናዳ የክልል መሪዎች የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የ50 በመቶ ቀረጥ መጣላቸውን ተከትሎ በእሳቸው ላይ ያላቸውን እምነት ማጣታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ለዚህ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ምላሽ ለመስጠት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ ካናዳ ተመሳሳይ የሆነ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ የንግድ ውዝግብ በሁለቱ አገሮች መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት በእጅጉ እያሻከረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni naannolee Kaanaadaa, pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp meeshaalee Kaanaadaa biyya isaanii seenan irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 ergaa taa'anii booda amanannaa akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfii diinagdee kanaaf deebii kennuuf, ministirri muummee Maark Kaarnii, Kaanaadaanis gibira walfakkaatu akka itti fufsiistu beeksisaniiru. Walitti bu’iinsi daldalaa kun biyyoota ollaa lamaan gidduutti rakkoo cimaa uumee jira.

title: Disabled, elderly Palestinian beaten with club by Israeli settler
english: An elderly Palestinian man named Saeed Al-Omour, who uses crutches due to a past injury, was assaulted by an Israeli settler in Hebron. Video footage reveals the settler striking the man with a club while he attempted to move away. This incident highlights the ongoing violence and threats faced by vulnerable residents in the occupied West Bank.
amharic: በሄብሮን ከተማ ሳኢድ አል-ኦሙር የተባሉ በእድሜ የገፉ እና በአካል ጉዳተኝነት ምክንያት በምትኩያ የሚራመዱ ፍልስጤማዊ በአንድ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪ በዱላ ተደብድበዋል። የተለቀቀው የቪዲዮ ምስል ሰፋሪው ሰውየውን በዱላ ሲመታቸው ያሳያል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ በነዋሪዎች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት እና ስጋት ያሳያል።
oromo: Namni umriin deebi'eefi miila tokko kan hin qabne, Sa'iid Al-Omur jedhaman, magaalaa Hebron keessatti namicha Israa'el tokkoon uleen reebamaniiru. Viidiyoon argame akka agarsiisutti, namichi sun Sa'iid yeroo ulee isaanii irratti deeman kan isaan reebuuf yaalu ta'uu mirkaneessa. Gochi kun haala nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa naannoo Weest Baanki keessatti jiraattota irratti raawwatamu kan mul'isu dha.

title: Six EU countries urge windfall tax on energy firms as profits soar due to Iran war
english: Finance ministers from six European nations have requested that the EU implement a tax on the excessive profits currently earned by oil companies. These officials argue that energy firms are profiting unfairly from supply disruptions caused by conflict in the Middle East. They believe this measure is necessary to address widespread public frustration regarding the rising cost of living.
amharic: ስድስት የአውሮፓ ህብረት ሀገራት የነዳጅ ኩባንያዎች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ግጭት ምክንያት እያገኙ ያሉትን ከፍተኛ ትርፍ ታክስ እንዲጣልበት ጠይቀዋል። የሀገራቱ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትሮች እንደሚሉት ከሆነ ኩባንያዎቹ ከጥሬ ዕቃ ዋጋ ንረት በላይ ትርፍ እያገኙ ነው። ይህም በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት ችግር ለመቅረፍ እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni maallaqaa biyyoota Awurooppaa ja'aa, kampaanonni boba'aa waraana giddu galeessa bahaa fayyadamuun bu'aa baay'ee argachaa jiran irratti gibiri akka bu'u gaafataniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa kunneen akka jedhanitti, bu'aan kampaanonni kun argachaa jiran gatii boba'aa addunyaa irra darbee kan jiruufi qaala'iinsa jireenyaa waliin kan wal qabatuudha. Kanaafuu, gibirri kun miidhaa gatii dabalaa jiru hir'isuuf akka gargaaru amanu.

title: US set to remove Syria from 'sponsors of terrorism' list
english: The United States is preparing to remove Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism after nearly 47 years. This decision follows the collapse of the former Assad regime and the new government's commitment to counterterrorism efforts and joining the coalition against ISIS. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is expected to finalize the process soon, making Syria the first nation removed from the list since 2020.
amharic: አሜሪካ ሶሪያን ከሽብርተኝነት ስፖንሰር አድራጊ አገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ ከ47 ዓመታት በኋላ በይፋ ለመሰረዝ እየተዘጋጀች ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው የአሳድ መንግስት መውደቅን ተከትሎ አዲሱ የሶሪያ አስተዳደር አሸባሪዎችን ለመዋጋትና ከአይሲስ ጋር በሚደረገው ትግል ለመተባበር ቃል በመግባቱ ነው። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ሂደቱን በቅርቡ እንደሚያጠናቅቁት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Amerikaa biyya Sooriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota gargaaran jedhamanii ibsamanii turan keessaa waggaa 47 booda haquuf qophii xumuraa irra jirti. Murteen kun kan dhufey mootummaan Assaad erga kufee booda, mootummaan cehumsaa haaraan shororkeessummaa ittisuufi hiriira diinota IS IS wajjin ta'uuf waadaa waan seeneefidha. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoon adeemsa kana gara fuulduraatti ifa akka taasisan eegama.

title: In rural Chad, solar kiosks bring healthcare closer
english: In rural Chad, solar-powered telemedicine kiosks are making healthcare more accessible by allowing patients to consult with doctors remotely. These kiosks use solar energy to function in areas without reliable electricity and provide basic medical diagnostic tools. This initiative helps residents save money and time by avoiding long trips to distant cities for medical care.
amharic: በገጠር ቻድ የሚገኙ በፀሐይ ኃይል የሚሰሩ የቴሌሜዲኬን መደብሮች ታካሚዎች ከሩቅ ሆነው ከዶክተሮች ጋር እንዲማከሩ በማድረግ የጤና አገልግሎትን ተደራሽ እያደረጉ ነው። እነዚህ መደብሮች የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት በሌለባቸው አካባቢዎች በፀሐይ ኃይል የሚሰሩ ሲሆን መሰረታዊ የህክምና ምርመራዎችንም ያከናውናሉ። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ነዋሪዎች ወደ ከተማ ለመሄድ የሚያወጡትን ከፍተኛ ወጪ እና ጊዜ በመቀነስ የጤና አገልግሎታቸውን በአቅራቢያቸው እንዲያገኙ አግዟቸዋል።
oromo: Ganda Chad keessatti, kiyooskiiwwan telee-hospitaala anniisaa aduutiin hojjatan dhukkubsattoonni doktoorota waliin karaa fagoo akka wal-qunnaman gochuun tajaajila fayyaa salphaa godhaniiru. Kiyooskiiwwan kun elektirikii hin jirre keessatti anniisaa aduutiin hojjatuufi meeshaalee qorannoo fayyaa bu'uuraa kan of keessaa qabaniid. Haalli kun jiraattonni magaalaatti deddeebi'uuf baasii fi yeroo hedduu akka hin baasne gargaaruun, tajaajila fayyaa bakka jiranitti akka argatan taasiseera.

title: Chinese robot beats Usain Bolt’s 100m world record at humanoid games
english: A Chinese humanoid robot named Tianzhuo has successfully broken the 100-meter world record by finishing the sprint in just 9.39 seconds. This performance surpassed the legendary 9.58-second record held by athlete Usain Bolt. The robot achieved this feat while competing against other machines at the World Humanoid Robot Games held in Beijing.
amharic: ቲያንዡዎ የተባለ የቻይና የሰው ቅርጽ ያለው ሮቦት የ100 ሜትር ሩጫን በ9.39 ሰከንድ በማጠናቀቅ የአለም ክብረ ወሰንን ሰብሯል። ይህ አፈጻጸም በሯጭ ዩሴን ቦልት ተይዞ የነበረውን የ9.58 ሰከንድ ክብረ ወሰን ማለፍ ችሏል። ሮቦቱ ይህን ድል የተቀዳጀው በቤጂንግ በተካሄደው የዓለም የሂዩማኖይድ ሮቦቶች ውድድር ላይ ሌሎች ሮቦቶችን በማሸነፍ ነው።
oromo: Robotii bifa namaa qabu kan Chaayinaa Tianzhuo jedhamu, fiigicha meetira 100 yeroo sekondii 9.39 keessatti xumuruun riikardii addunyaa cabseera. Gosti fiigicha kanaa riikardii atileetii Yuuseen Boolt kan 9.58 ture caaleera. Robotichi injifannoo kana kan gonfate magaalaa Beejingitti qophii dorgommii roboototaa irratti dorgomtoota isaa kaan dursuudhaan.

title: Palestinian commission: Illegal Israeli settlements in West Bank reach 592 by July
english: A Palestinian report indicates that there are now 592 Israeli settlements and outposts located in the occupied West Bank, housing approximately 780,000 settlers. These expansion efforts have resulted in Israel controlling more than 40 percent of the West Bank territory. Several nations have officially criticized these settlement policies and specifically rejected new construction plans in the E1 area.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ኮሚሽን መረጃ እንደሚያመለክተው በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኙ ህገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ቁጥር 592 ደርሷል፤ እነዚህም ሰፈራዎች ወደ 780,000 የሚጠጉ ሰፋሪዎችን ይዘዋል። ይህ መስፋፋት እስራኤል ከዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ከ40 በመቶ በላይ እንድትቆጣጠር አስችሏታል። በርካታ ሀገራት የእስራኤልን የሰፈራ ፖሊሲ በይፋ በመቃወም በተለይም በኢ1 አካባቢ የሚካሄደውን አዲስ ግንባታ ውድቅ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Gabaasni komishinii Palastayinii akka mul'isutti, lafa lixaa (West Bank) keessatti manneen jireenyaa fi buufatni Israa'el seeraan alaa 592 ga'aniiru; isaan kunis namoota 780,000 ol ta'an of keessatti qabatu. Babal'inni kun Israa'el lafa lixaa keessaa harka 40 ol akka to'attu taasiseera. Mootummoonni biyyoota hedduu imaammata qubsuma Israa'el balaaleffachuun, keessattuu ijaarsa haaraa naannoo E1 jedhamutti karoorfame mormaniiru.

title: Aipac told to stay away from pro-Israel Mike Rogers' campaign, report says
english: Mike Rogers, the Republican Senate candidate in Michigan, has requested that Aipac refrain from running campaign advertisements in his favor. His team fears that the group's involvement could become a political disadvantage due to widespread voter frustration regarding the conflict in Gaza. Rogers aims to avoid the scrutiny that his opponent, Abdul El-Sayed, successfully used against his previous rival by framing Aipac’s massive spending as a negative influence.
amharic: ሚቺጋን ውስጥ የሚወዳደሩት የሪፐብሊካን ሴኔት እጩ ማይክ ሮጀርስ፣ አይፓክ (Aipac) ለግልቢያቸው ማስታወቂያዎችን እንዳይሰራ ጠይቀዋል። የሮጀርስ ቡድን በጋዛ ስላለው ጦርነት ህዝቡ ባለው ቁጣ የተነሳ፣ የድርጅቱ ድጋፍ ለምርጫው ሊጎዳቸው እንደሚችል በመስጋት ይህን ውሳኔ አሳልፈዋል። ተቀናቃኛቸው አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ፣ የአይፓክን የወጪ አቅም ተጠቅመው ተፎካካሪዎቻቸውን በመተቸት ስኬታማ እንደሆኑ በመታዘብ፣ ሮጀርስ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃት መሰንዘሪያ መሆንን ለመከላከል ነው ይህን ጥያቄ ያቀረቡት።
oromo: Kaadhimamtoota seeneetii Rippabilikaanootaa kan biyya Michigan Mike Rogers, gareen Aipac deggersa isaanif beeksisa akka hin baasne gaafataniiru. Gareen kun lola Gaazaarratti hirmaachuu isaatiin walqabatee, deggersi isaanii filannicha irratti miidhaa akka geessisu waan sodaataniifi. Rogers morkataan isaanii Abdul El-Sayed, maallaqa Aipac baasuun dhiibbaa godha jechuun morkattoota isaanii akka miidhe waan hubataniif, isaanis tarkaanfii walfakkaataa kana irraa fagaachuuf yaalan.

title: Macron to host Saudi crown prince for talks on Middle East, energy
english: French President Emmanuel Macron is welcoming Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman for a two-day diplomatic visit. The two leaders plan to address regional instability in the Middle East while also strengthening bilateral ties through cooperation in health, energy, and transportation. Additionally, the visit includes an appearance at the Esports World Cup, marking the first time this competition is held outside of Saudi Arabia.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፕሬዝዳንት አማኑኤል ማክሮን የሳዑዲው አልጋ ወራሽ መሐመድ ቢን ሳልማንን ለሁለት ቀን ይፋዊ ጉብኝት አስተናግደዋል። መሪዎቹ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለውን የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ከመወያየታቸው በተጨማሪ በጤና፣ በኢነርጂ እና በትራንስፖርት ዘርፎች ያላቸውን ትብብር ለማጠናከር አቅደዋል። ጉብኝቱ በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ድጋፍ የሚካሄደውን የኢ-ስፖርት የዓለም ዋንጫን መካተት ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ክንውኖችን ያካትታል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Faransaay Eemaanu'eel Maakroon, aangonni hordoffii mootii Sa'uudii Mohammed biin Salmaan guyyoota lamaaf biyyattii akka daawwatan simataniiru. Hoggantoonni lamaan kun nageenya garaa garaa fi tasgabbii giddu gala bahaa irratti mari'achuun, walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii damee fayyaa, anniisaa fi geejjibaa irratti cimsuuf karoorfataniiru. Daawwannaan kun tapha ispoortii elektirooniksii (esports) kan Sa'uudiin gargaartu ilaalatus kan dabalatu ta'a.

title: Tear gas shelling, detentions, property theft reported during West Bank raids
english: Israeli military forces and settlers have conducted a series of raids across several West Bank cities and villages, resulting in multiple injuries and arrests. At least eleven Palestinians, including children, required medical attention after inhaling tear gas fired during these operations. Additionally, reports indicate that settlers confiscated property from local communities, while military personnel detained several individuals during their incursions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በተለያዩ የምዕራብ ባንክ ከተሞች እና መንደሮች ባደረሱት ጥቃት በርካታ ጉዳቶች እና እስሮች ተፈጽመዋል። በዚህ ወረራ ወቅት በተተኮሰ የለቅሶ ጋዝ ምክንያት አራት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ አስራ አንድ ፍልስጤማውያን የህክምና እርዳታ ማግኘት ነበረባቸው። በተጨማሪም ሰፋሪዎች የሀገር በቀል ነዋሪዎችን ንብረት እንደዘረፉ እና ወታደሮቹም በኦፕሬሽኑ ወቅት በርካታ ሰዎችን ማሰራቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el fi qubattoonni isaanii magaalonni fi gandaalee mandhee lixaa keessatti sochiilee godhaniin miidhaa fi hidhaan garaagaraa gahuu gabaasameera. Duula kana keessatti gaasii imimmaan fiduu itti fayyadamuun ijoollee afur dabalatee palastiinoonni kudha tokko dhukkuba hafuuraa irratti mudatee yaala argataniiru. Kana malees, qubattoonni qabeenya jiraattotaa saamuun, waraannis sochiilee isaanii kanaan namoota hedduu hidhaatti darbuun isaanii ibsameera.

title: 'Palestinian state already a reality', says Arab Israeli leader Mansour Abbas
english: Mansour Abbas, an Arab Israeli politician, has urged Israel to formally acknowledge an independent Palestinian state, arguing that it is already a de facto reality supported by most of the world. He stated that such recognition is essential to fostering peace and resolving the long-standing conflict. His remarks faced strong criticism from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and other political leaders who firmly oppose this stance.
amharic: የእስራኤል አረብ ፖለቲከኛ መንሱር አባስ፣ እስራኤል ነጻ የፍልስጤም መንግሥትን በይፋ እንድታውቅ ጠይቀዋል። አባስ እንዳሉት፣ የፍልስጤም መንግሥት መኖር አብዛኛው የዓለም ሀገራት የተቀበሉት እውነታ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ለሰላም እና ለግጭቱ መፍትሄ ለማምጣት አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ቢናገሩም፣ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና በሌሎች የእስራኤል መሪዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል።
oromo: Manni maree siyaasaa Israa'el kan ta'an Mansuur Abbaas, Israa'el mootummaa Filisxeem kan bilisa ta'e akka beekamtii kennituuf gaafataniiru. Mootummaan Filisxeem dhugaa addunyaan hedduun fudhatte akka ta'e kan ibsan Abbaas, beekamtii kennuun kun nagaa buusuufi walitti bu'iinsa xumuruuf murteessaa akka ta'e himaniiru. Yaada isaanii kana irratti muummichi ministeeraa Benyaamin Neetaanyaahufi hogganoonni siyaasaa biroo Israa'el mormii cimaa dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Canada to hit US with retaliatory tariffs as trade war escalates
english: Canada has announced plans to impose retaliatory tariffs on American goods, including steel and electronics, starting September 8. This decision follows Washington's implementation of heavy taxes on $20 billion worth of Canadian products after recent trade negotiations failed. Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that Canada would match the US tariffs dollar for dollar to defend its national interests and local industries from what he described as unfair demands.
amharic: ካናዳ ከሴፕቴምበር 8 ጀምሮ በአሜሪካ የብረት፣ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ እና ሌሎች ምርቶች ላይ የበቀል ቀረጥ እንደምትጥል አስታውቃለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ዋሽንግተን በ20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ግብር ከጣለች በኋላ የንግድ ድርድሮች መቋረጣቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ እንዳሉት ካናዳ የሀገሪቱን የንግድ ጥቅምና ሰራተኞች ለመከላከል ሲባል የአሜሪካን ቀረጥ በራሷ ቀረጥ እንደምትመልስ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Kanaadaan gabaa Ameerikaa irraa gara biyyaatti galan kan akka sibiilaa fi meeshaalee elektirooniksii irratti, ergaa Fulbaana 8 kaasee gibira addaa akka keessu beeksifteetti. Murtuun kun kan dhufu, mootummaan Ameerikaa meeshaalee Kanaadaa gatii dolaara biliyoona 20 baasanii irratti gibira cimaa erga kaffalchiisee fi mariin daldalaa erga fashalaa'ee booda. Muummeen Ministiraa Maark Kaarnii akka ibsanitti, Kanaadaan fedhii biyya ishee fi hojjettoota ishee kabachiisuuf jecha, Ameerikaan gibira ishee irratti kaastee wajjin walmadaaluu danda'u akka deebiftu ibsaniiru.

title: Central Bank Writes Rulebooks for Billion-Birr Market Already Exists
english: The Central Bank of Ethiopia is developing a new regulatory framework to formalize the rapidly growing interest-free banking sector. This strategy will equalize tax treatment for Sharia-compliant finance, introduce Islamic investment bonds known as Sukuk, and establish a national oversight body. Furthermore, it provides a roadmap for existing interest-free banking windows within conventional banks to potentially transition into independent financial institutions.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ማዕከላዊ ባንክ በፍጥነት እያደገ ላለው ወለድ-አልባ የባንክ አገልግሎት አዲስ የቁጥጥር ማዕቀፍ እያዘጋጀ ነው። ይህ ስትራቴጂ ወለድ-አልባ የፋይናንስ አገልግሎትን ከሌሎች ባንኮች ጋር እኩል የታክስ ሥርዓት እንዲኖረው ከማድረጉም በላይ፣ የሱኩክ ቦንዶችን በማስተዋወቅ ብሔራዊ የሸሪዓ ተገዢነት ቁጥጥር ሥርዓት ይዘረጋል። በተጨማሪም፣ አሁን ባሉ የባንክ ተቋማት ውስጥ ያሉ ወለድ-አልባ ክፍሎች ወደ ሙሉ የፋይናንስ ተቋምነት የሚያድጉበትን መንገድ ያመቻቻል።
oromo: Baankiin giddu galeessaa Itoophiyaa damee baankii dhala-bilisaa (interest-free) saffisaan guddachaa jiruuf qajeelfama haaraa baasuuf qophaa'aa jira. Karoorri kun tajaajila maallaqaa Shari'aa eeggatee fi baankiiwwan aadaa gidduutti walqixxummaa gibiraa akka uumu, akkasumas 'Sukuk' jedhamu kanneen jedhaman hojiirra oolchuu fi qaama biyyoolessaa kan Shari'aa hordofu dhaabuuf gargaara. Kana malees, dameewwan baankii dhala-bilisaa kan yeroo ammaa baankiiwwan idilee keessa jiran gara dhaabbata maallaqaa guutuu fi ofdanda'aatti akka guddatan karaa ni agarsiisa.

title: The City Wants to Widen Its Tax Net. Shops Feel It Tighten
english: The Addis Ababa City Administration is aggressively pursuing a high revenue target of half a trillion Birr for the current fiscal year by expanding its tax base. Small business owners report that they are being unfairly targeted with multiple tax assessments, placing a heavy financial burden on them. While officials insist these measures are necessary to increase city income, shopkeepers argue that the tax pressure is falling disproportionately on those already participating in the system.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር በያዝነው በጀት ዓመት ግማሽ ትሪሊዮን ብር ገቢ ለመሰብሰብ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረገ ይገኛል። የከተማዋ አስተዳደር የግብር አሰባሰብ መረብን ለማስፋት በሚል አነስተኛ ንግድ ድርጅቶች ላይ በተደጋጋሚ ግምገማ በማድረጉ ቅሬታ አስነስቷል። ነጋዴዎች አዲሱ አሰራር ቀድሞውኑ ግብር ለሚከፍሉ ሰዎች ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ጫና መፍጠሩን ሲገልጹ፣ የከተማዋ ባለስልጣናት ግን አሰራሩ የገቢ አቅምን ለማሳደግ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Bulchiinsi magaalaa Finfinnee baajata bara kanaa keessatti galii walakkaa tiriliyoona birrii sassaabudhaaf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jira. Bulchiinsi kun toora gibiraa bal’isuuf jechuun waldaalee daldala xixiqqoo irratti qorannoo deddeebi’ee taasisuun isaa komii kaaseera. Daldaltoonni haalli kun namoota kanaan dura gibira kaffalaa turan irratti ba’ii maallaqaa ulfaataa ta’e uumuu isaanii yoo himan, qondaalonni magaalaas tarkaanfichi galii magaalattii guddisuuf dirqama ta’uu ibsu.

title: Wegagen Capital Cuts Reserve as It Reaches for More Capital
english: Wegagen Capital Investment Bank recently concluded its first profitable year and held its second shareholders' meeting in Bishoftu. During the meeting, stakeholders unanimously agreed to reduce the bank's annual legal reserve from 25 percent to 5 percent. This strategy aims to free up more capital for business growth by moving away from traditional commercial banking reserve practices.
amharic: ወጋገን ካፒታል ኢንቨስትመንት ባንክ የመጀመሪያውን ትርፋማ ዓመት ካጠናቀቀ በኋላ በቢሾፍቱ ሁለተኛውን የባለአክሲዮኖች ስብሰባ አካሂዷል። በስብሰባው ላይ ባለአክሲዮኖች የባንኩን ዓመታዊ ህጋዊ ክምችት ከ25 በመቶ ወደ 5 በመቶ ዝቅ ለማድረግ በአንድ ድምፅ ተስማምተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ባንኩ ከተለመደው የንግድ ባንኮች አሠራር በመውጣት ለዕድገት የሚያውለውን የገንዘብ መጠን ለመጨመር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Wagagen Kaappitaal Invaastimant Baankiin waggaa isaa jalqabaa bu'aa qabeessa ta'e erga xumuree booda, walga'ii abbootii qabeenyaa isa lammaffaa Bishooftuutti geggeeffateera. Walga'icharratti, abbootii qabeenyaan qusannoo seeraa waggaa baankichaa dhibbeentaa 25 irraa gara dhibbeentaa 5tti gadi hir'isuuf waliigalaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun baankiin seera qusannoo baankiiwwan daldalaa aadaa irraa fooyyee, guddinaaf dabalata qarshii argachuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Judges Keep Sandford Students in Their Seats as the Fee War Escalates
english: The Federal High Court has issued an injunction preventing Sandford School from expelling students or reassigning their spots due to outstanding fee payments. This legal action comes as the school and families remain locked in a dispute regarding whether tuition should be settled in local currency or U.S. dollars. The ruling ensures that students can remain in their classrooms while the court addresses the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የፌዴራል ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ሳንድፎርድ ትምህርት ቤት ያልተከፈለ የትምህርት ክፍያን ምክንያት በማድረግ ተማሪዎችን ከትምህርት ገበታቸው እንዳይቀንሱ እና ቦታቸውንም ለሌላ እንዳይሰጡ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥቷል። ክርክሩ የትምህርት ክፍያው በብር መከፈል እንዳለበት ወይስ በዶላር በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ያጠነጠነ ነው። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህንን ውሳኔ ያስተላለፈው ጉዳዩ በህግ እስኪጣራ ድረስ ተማሪዎች ትምህርታቸውን እንዲቀጥሉ ለማድረግ ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa federaalaatti, mana barnootaa Saandfoordiin kaffaltii hin kaffalamne sababeeffachuun barattoota ari’uu ykn bakka isaanii namoota biroof kennuu akka hin dandeenye dhorkeera. Falmichi kan irratti xiyyeeffatu kaffaltiin barnootaa birriidhaan moo doolaaraan kaffalamuu akka qabu irratti dha. Murteen kun, falmii kaffaltii kanaa ilaalchisee adeemaa jiru keessatti barattoonni barnoota isaanii akka itti fufan mirkaneesseera.

title: Fed Tests a Payment Window for the Whole Government, Starting with Health
english: Federal authorities are launching a pilot program to create a unified digital payment system for all government services, starting with the health sector. This platform aims to replace the current fragmented approach by allowing citizens to make payments through their preferred banks or existing digital channels. The initiative seeks to streamline public transactions and eliminate the need for agencies to manage independent payment systems.
amharic: የፌደራል ባለስልጣናት በጤናው ዘርፍ በመጀመር ለሁሉም የመንግስት አገልግሎቶች የሚሆን አንድ የተቀናጀ የዲጂታል ክፍያ ስርዓት ለመዘርጋት ሙከራ ጀምረዋል። ይህ መድረክ ዜጎች የሚጠቀሙባቸውን ባንኮች ወይም ዲጂታል መንገዶች ተጠቅመው ክፍያ እንዲፈጽሙ በማድረግ አሁን ያለውን የተበታተነ አሰራር ለመተካት ታቅዷል። ይህ አዲስ እርምጃ የመንግስት መስሪያ ቤቶች በተናጥል የክፍያ ስርዓቶችን እንዳይጠቀሙ በማድረግ የአገልግሎት አሰጣጡን ለማቀላጠፍ ይረዳል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa federalaa tajaajila mootummaa hundaaf kan ta'u sirna kaffaltii dijitaalaa tokko damee fayyaa irraa jalqabuun qorachaa jiru. Sirni kun lammiileen baankiiwwan isaan itti fayyadaman ykn karaa dijitaalaa filatan fayyadamanii tajaajila mootummaa akka kaffalan taasisa. Hojii kun sirna kaffaltii kanneen dameewwan mootummaa adda addaa of danda'anii hojjechaa turan tokko gochuun tajaajila saffisaa fi salphaa ta'e kennuuf gargaara.

title: Thousands flee Sudan’s Kordofan fighting for relative safety of El Obeid
english: Escalating clashes between the Sudanese military and the Rapid Support Forces have forced over 200,000 people to leave their homes in the Kordofan region. Thousands of families are seeking refuge in the city of El Obeid to escape the dangerous conditions. This mass movement of civilians highlights the intensifying humanitarian crisis caused by the ongoing conflict in Sudan.
amharic: በሱዳን ጦር እና በፍጥነት ድጋፍ ሰጪ ኃይሎች መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ከ200,000 በላይ የኮርዶፋን ክልል ነዋሪዎችን ከቤት ንብረታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጓል። ከግጭቱ ለመዳን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤተሰቦች ወደ ኤል ኦቤድ ከተማ በመጠለል ላይ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ መፈናቀል በሱዳን እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት አስከፊ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ እየፈጠረ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Waraana biyya Sudaan fi garee 'Rapid Support Forces' gidduutti adeemaa jiruun walqabatee, namoonni 200,000 ol ta'an naannoo Kordofaanii qe'ee isaanii dhiisanii baqachuuf dirqamaniiru. Maatiin kumaatamaan lakkaawaman waraana kana irraa jireenya isaanii oolchuuf gara magaalaa El Obeid baqachaa jiru. Kunuunis rakkoon namoomaa fi buqqaatiin siviilotaa biyyattii keessatti hammaachaa adeemu isaa ibsa.

title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike
english: A 48-year-old man was reprimanded by Japanese police after he left his 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue his hike with his older child. The boy was found waiting in cold, rainy weather for several hours before mountain staff discovered him and contacted authorities. The father later apologized for his poor decision, though officials emphasized that leaving a child unattended in such a dangerous environment is completely unacceptable.
amharic: አንድ የ48 ዓመት አባት ልጁን በፉጂ ተራራ ላይ ለብቻው ትቶ ከሌላኛው ልጁ ጋር ጉዞውን በመቀጠሉ በጃፓን ፖሊስ ተገሰጸ። ሰባት ዓመቱ ህጻን በዝናባማ እና ቀዝቃዛ የአየር ሁኔታ ውስጥ ለብዙ ሰዓታት ብቻውን ሲጠብቅ በተራራው ሰራተኞች ተገኝቶ ለፖሊስ ጥቆማ ደርሷል። አባቱ ድርጊቱን በቁጭት ይቅርታ ቢጠይቅም፣ ባለስልጣናት ህጻናትን በተራራ አደገኛ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ትቶ መሄድ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Abbaan umriin isaa waggaa 48 ta'e tokko ilma isaa waggaa 7 gara tulluu Fuji irratti kophaatti dhiisee ilma isaa isa hangafaa wajjin imala isaa itti fufuun isaa poolisii Japaniin akeekkachiifameera. Mucaan kun haala qilleensa qorraa fi bokkaa keessa sa'aatii hedduuf kophaatti erga egee booda hojjattoota gaara sanaa biratti argamee poolisiin gahuun isaa ibsameera. Abbaan kun murtii isaa kanaaf dhiifama gaafateus, aanga'oonni ijoollee bakka akkanaa keessatti kophaatti dhiisuun fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu jabeessanii ibsaniiru.

title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
english: The Syrian government has condemned a recent Israeli airstrike near Damascus, which reportedly injured several civilians and violated Syrian sovereignty. Israel stated the attack was aimed at a terrorist threat, marking its second military strike in the region within a single week. These incidents have fueled broader regional tensions, especially concerning conflicting claims between Israeli, Syrian, and Turkish interests regarding military movements.
amharic: የሶሪያ መንግሥት በቅርቡ በደማስቆ አቅራቢያ በእስራኤል የተፈጸመውን የአየር ጥቃት የሉዓላዊነቱ ጥሰት ነው ሲል አውግዟል። ይህ ጥቃት በርካታ ሲቪሎችን ጉዳት ላይ የጣለ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤል በበኩሏ የአሸባሪ ቡድን ስጋትን ለመከላከል እንደወሰደችው እርምጃ ገልጻለች። በአንድ ሳምንት ውስጥ የተፈጸሙት እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች በእስራኤል፣ በሶሪያ እና በቱርክ መካከል ያለውን ቀጠናዊ ውጥረት እንዲባባስ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa miidhaa ga'e kan balaaleffate yoo ta'u, haleellaan kun kabaja biyyattii kan cabse fi namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa kan qaqqabsiise ta'uu ibseera. Israa'el gama ishiitiin, haleellaan kun garee shororkeessaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate fi biyyattii irraa balaa ittisuuf kan fudhatame tarkaanfii ta'uu ibsite. Haleellaan torban tokko keessatti irra deddeebi'ame kun, walitti dhufeenya Israa'el, Suuriyaa fi Turkii gidduu jiru daran kan hammaachise ta'uu gabaasichi ni ibsa.

title: Iran war live: Tehran warns neighbours against joining US economic war
english: Iranian official Mohsen Rezaei has issued a stern warning to neighboring countries, stating that any nation supporting US sanctions against Iran will be treated as an enemy. He emphasized that Tehran is prepared to retaliate by targeting the interests of these states. This development follows remarks by President Trump, who recently claimed the Strait of Hormuz is effectively under American control.

oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iraan Mohsen Rezaei biyyoota ollaa ishee irratti akeekkachiisa cimaa kennaniiru. Biyyoonni Iraan irratti adabbii diinagdee Ameerikaa deggeran akka diinaatti kan ilaalaman ta'uu fi Iraanis bakka bu'uudhaan faayidaa biyyoota kanaa irratti tarkaanfii kan fudhattu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaanti Traamp galkaan Hormuz harka Ameerikaa jala jira jedhanii dubbatanii booda dha.

title: Iran threatens countries that join US ‘economic D-Day’
english: Iranian official Mohsen Rezaei has warned that nations participating in U.S.-led economic sanctions against Iran will face direct retaliation. This statement follows President Donald Trump's declaration of economic warfare against the country. The tension highlights an escalating conflict as Iran promises a reciprocal response to any foreign involvement in American pressure campaigns.

oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran, biyyoota sagantaa diinagdee Ameerikaan Iran irratti labsite hordofan irratti tarkaanfiin haaloo bahuu akka fudhatamu akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Iran irratti waraana diinagdee akka banan himanii boodadha. Iran, biyyoonni dhiibbaa Ameerikaa keessatti hirmaatan hundi deebii wal-fakkaataa akka argatan beeksisteetti.

title: Trump posts map showing Hormuz as 'new US territory'
english: Donald Trump recently shared a map on social media labeling the Strait of Hormuz as American territory. During a rally, he reiterated his claim that the strategic waterway is currently under U.S. control. He also emphasized his firm stance against Iran's ability to acquire nuclear weapons.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአሜሪካ ግዛት የሚያሳይ ካርታ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለቀዋል። በሰጡት ንግግርም ይህ ስትራቴጂያዊ የውሃ መስመር በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ ቁጥጥር ስር እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለማድረግ ያላቸውን ቁርጠኝነት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Donald Tiraamp kaartaa 'Strait of Hormuz' biyya Ameerikaa jala akka jiru agarsiisu miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti gadhiisaniiru. Walgahii uummataa tokko irratti akka dubbatanitti, daandii bishaanii barbaachisaa ta'e kana amma kan to'achaa jiru Ameerikaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Iraan meeshaa niwukilaraa akka hin arganne gochuuf murannoo qaban ibsaniiru.

title: GCC, Abu Dhabi-based Muslim Council of Elders condemn Israeli settlement plans
english: The Muslim Council of Elders and the Gulf Cooperation Council have formally denounced Israel's latest plans to expand settlements in the West Bank and East Jerusalem. Both organizations argued that these construction projects violate international law and represent a significant obstacle to achieving a lasting peace. They emphasized that such actions threaten the creation of an independent Palestinian state by dividing the territory and ignoring global calls for stability.
amharic: የሙስሊም ሽማግሌዎች ምክር ቤት እና የባህረ ሰላጤው የትብብር ምክር ቤት እስራኤል በምዕራብ ባንክ እና በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሰፈራ ግንባታ ለማካሄድ ያቀደችውን እቅድ አውግዘዋል። ሁለቱም ተቋማት እነዚህ እቅዶች አለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥሱ እና ለዘላቂ ሰላም ትልቅ እንቅፋት የሚፈጥሩ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። እንደነዚህ ያሉ ድርጊቶች የተያዘውን መሬት በመከፋፈል እና የአለም አቀፍ ማህበረሰብን ጥሪ ችላ በማለት ሉዓላዊ የፍልስጤም መንግስት እንዳይመሰረት ስጋት እንደሚደቅኑ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gumii Manguddoota Muslimaa fi Kutaaleen Walta'iinsa Goolfii (GCC) karoora Israa'el naannoo Qarqara Lixaa fi Baha Yerusaalemitti manneen jireenyaa ijaaruuf qabatte balaaleffataniiru. Dhaabbileen kun akka jedhanitti, karooreen kun seera addunyaa kan cabsuu fi nageenya dhugoomsuuf carraaqqii godhamu kan gufachiisuudha. Gochi akkanaa kun lafa Falasxiin gargar cicciruun biyya of danda'e ijaaruuf carraa jiru akka balleessu fi nagaa naannichaa akka miidhu ibsaniiru.

title: Gharibabadi says London, Paris ‘deliberately’ participating in Israeli crimes
english: Iran's deputy foreign minister, Kazem Gharibabadi, accused the UK and France of actively supporting Israeli crimes by continuing to supply weapons. He dismissed their official expressions of concern as insufficient and urged them to stop military aid, citing warnings from their own diplomats regarding potential ethnic cleansing. Gharibabadi insisted these nations must take tangible steps, such as halting trade with settlements, instead of hiding behind diplomatic rhetoric.
amharic: የኢራን ምክትል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ካዚም ጋሪባባዲ፣ እንግሊዝና ፈረንሳይ ለእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያ በማቅረብ በፈጸመቻቸው ወንጀሎች ውስጥ ተባባሪ መሆናቸውን ከሰሱ። እነዚህ አገራት ለችግሩ ያላቸውን ስጋት ከመግለጽ ባለፈ፣ የጦር መሳሪያ ድጋፋቸውን በማቆም እና ህገወጥ የሰፈራ ንግዶችን በመከልከል ተግባራዊ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ አሳስበዋል። ዲፕሎማቶቻቸውም እንኳ እስራኤል እየወሰደችው ያለው እርምጃ የዘር ማጥፋትን ሊያስከትል እንደሚችል ማስጠንቀቃቸውን አስታውሰዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan, Kaazim Gaaribabaadii, biyyoonni Ingilizii fi Firaansi meeshaa waraanaa dhiyeessuudhaan gochoota Israa'el yakka ta'an keessatti hirmaachaa jiru jechuun himatan. Biyyoonni kun yaaddoo ibsuun qofaatti osoo hin taane, gargaarsa waraanaa dhaabuu fi daldala naannoo lafa qabamee waliin jiru dhoorkuudhaan tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Akkasumas, hayyoonni diippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii kun Israa'el tarkaanfii suukanneessaa fudhachaa jirtuun saboota balleessuuf yaada jiru jechuun akeekkachiisuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Hamas says not obligated to implement Trump Gaza deal unless Israel accepts it
english: Hamas official Osama Hamdan stated that the group will not follow any terms of the proposed Gaza peace plan unless Israel officially agrees to it and fulfills its requirements, such as ending military actions and withdrawing forces. He clarified that Hamas refuses to give up its weapons, proposing instead that heavy arms be stored under Palestinian control while halting all cross-border attacks. Ultimately, Hamdan emphasized that any progress on disarmament talks depends entirely on whether Israel accepts the broader framework for peace.

oromo: Hoggantoonni Hamas Osama Hamdaan akka ibsanitti, Israa'el karoora nagaa Gaazaarratti dhiyaate fudhattee tarkaanfii waraanaa ishee hin dhaabne yoo ta'e, Hamas dirqama kanaan hidhachuu akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Gareen kun meeshaa waraanaa isaa gadi dhiisuuf fedhii akka hin qabne kan ibsan yoo ta'u, meeshaan ulfaataan to'annoo Palastiinii jala akka turu yaada dhiyeessaniiru. Dhumarrattis, mariin hidhannoo hiikuufi dhimmoonni nagaa biroo kan milkaa'an Israa'el walii galtee nagaa kana guutummaatti yeroo fudhattu qofa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Iran warns nearby nations against joining US ‘economic war’ efforts
english: Iran has issued a stern warning to neighboring nations, stating that those who support the United States' economic pressure campaign will be viewed as enemies and face potential retaliation. This comes after President Trump announced plans for severe economic measures to undermine the Iranian government amid ongoing hostilities. Iranian officials emphasized that they prefer diplomacy to avoid broader conflict, but they are prepared to take direct action against countries that continue to cooperate with the American sanctions.

title: Tropical Storm Moke advances towards Hawaii with heavy rain, strong winds
english: Tropical Storm Moke is currently approaching Hawaii, bringing the threat of strong winds and heavy rainfall just one week after Hurricane Lala caused significant damage. While the storm is not expected to hit the islands directly, local authorities are urging residents to prepare for potential flooding and power issues. Officials have already begun organizing emergency supplies and housing to support the recovery efforts from the previous storm.
amharic: ሞኬ የተባለ ሞቃታማ አውሎ ንፋስ ከአንድ ሳምንት በፊት በሃዋይ ከደረሰው የላላ አውሎ ንፋስ ጉዳት ሳያገግሙ በድጋሚ ወደ አካባቢው እየተጠጋ ይገኛል። አውሎ ንፋሱ ደሴቶቹን በቀጥታ ባይመታም፣ በውስጡ የያዘው ከባድ ዝናብ እና ንፋስ ሊያስከትል ስለሚችል ነዋሪዎች ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ተመክሯል። ባለስልጣናት ቀደም ሲል ለደረሰው ጉዳት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ዝግጅቶችን እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎችም አስፈላጊ ቁሳቁሶችን እንዲያዘጋጁ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin 'Moke' jedhamu kanneen torbee darbe obomboleettii 'Lala' tiin miidhama irraa fayyaa jiran iddoo Hawaii qaqqabaa jira. Obomboleettiin kun giddu galeessa Hawaii bakka bu'ee kan darbu ta'us, rooba cimaa fi qilleensa humna guddaa qabuun miidhaa biraa geessisuu waan danda'uuf, jiraattonni of eeggannoo gochuu akka qaban gorfamaniiru. Aangootonni mootummaa miidhaa darbe irraa harka qulqulleessuuf qophii taasisaa jiran yoo ta'u, jiraattonnis nyaataa fi qorichoota barbaachisaa ta'an akka of harkaa qabaatan dhaamaniiru.

title: Real Madrid beat Espanyol 2-1 in Jose Mourinho’s first game on return
english: Jose Mourinho began his second stint as Real Madrid manager with a narrow 2-1 victory against Espanyol. Jude Bellingham gave the visitors an early lead, but Espanyol managed to equalize before halftime. Ultimately, substitute Carlos Espi secured the win for Madrid with a decisive goal in the 90th minute.
amharic: ጆዜ ሞሪንሆ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የሪያል ማድሪድ አሰልጣኝ ሆነው በተረከቡበት የመጀመሪያ ጨዋታ ኤስፓኞልን 2 ለ 1 በማሸነፍ አሳካሚ ጅምር አድርገዋል። ጁድ ቤሊንግሃም ቡድኑን ቀዳሚ ቢያደርግም፣ ኤስፓኞል አቻ መሆን ችሎ ነበር። ሆኖም ተቀይሮ የገባው ካርሎስ ኤስፒ በጨዋታው የመጨረሻ ደቂቃ ባስቆጠራት ግብ ማድሪድ ድል እንዲቀናው አድርጓል።
oromo: ጆዜ ሞሪንሆ አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ወደ ሪያል ማድሪድ በተመለሱበት የመጀመሪያ ጨዋታ ኤስፓኞልን 2 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት ማሸነፍ ችለዋል። ጁድ ቤሊንግሃም ማድሪድን ቀዳሚ ቢያደርግም፣ ኤስፓኞል አቻ መውጣት ችሎ ነበር። በመጨረሻም ተቀይሮ የገባው ካርሎስ ኤስፒ በጨዋታው መገባደጃ ደቂቃ ላይ የድል ግብ በማስቆጠር ማድሪድ ነጥቡን እንዲያሳካ ረድቷል።

title: Open-air cinema brings movie nights back to Khartoum
english: Residents of Khartoum are finding a brief respite from the ongoing conflict by attending screenings at a newly opened outdoor cinema. Families are gathering to enjoy films, which provides a rare sense of normalcy in the war-torn city. However, organizers report that frequent electricity shortages continue to make it difficult to host these movie nights regularly.
amharic: በካርቱም የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች በተከፈተ የውጭ ሲኒማ አማካኝነት ከጦርነቱ የዕለት ተዕለት ጭንቀት በመላቀቅ ጊዜያዊ መዝናኛን እያገኙ ነው። ቤተሰቦች ፊልሞችን ለመመልከት በመሰብሰብ በተጎዳችው ከተማ ውስጥ ለጥቂት ጊዜም ቢሆን የመረጋጋት ስሜት እየተሰማቸው ነው። ይሁን እንጂ አዘጋጆቹ ተደጋጋሚ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ የፊልም ምሽቶቹን በየጊዜው እንዳያካሂዱ ትልቅ ፈተና እንደሆነባቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: jiraattonni magaalaa Khartoum, sinimaa bakka banaa ta'e kan amma baname keessatti fiilmii ilaaluun, waraana biyyattii keessa jiru irraa boqonnaa gabaabaa argachaa jiru. Maatiin fiilmii ilaaluuf walitti qabamuun, magaalattii waraanaan miidhamte keessatti tasgabbii fi gammachuu muraasa argachaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, qindeessitoonni akka jedhanitti, hir'inni humna ibsaa yeroo irraa gara yerootti mudatu galgala fiilmii kana qopheessuu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'ee jira.

title: Israeli army and settlers injure several Palestinians across West Bank
english: Israeli military forces and settlers have conducted a series of violent raids across the occupied West Bank, resulting in injuries to at least 19 Palestinians. These incidents include beatings by armed settlers, tear gas attacks, and shootings by military personnel. Local families are also facing ongoing displacement and intimidation as settler activity increases throughout the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች ባደረሱት ተከታታይ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 19 ፍልስጤማውያን ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጥቃቶቹ የታጠቁ ሰፋሪዎች የፈጸሙትን ድብደባ፣ የጋዝ ጥቃትን እና በወታደሮች የተፈጸሙ የተኩስ እርምጃዎችን ያካተቱ ናቸው። ሰፋሪዎች በክልሉ ያላቸው እንቅስቃሴ እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ከመኖሪያ ቤታቸው የመፈናቀል እና የማስፈራራት ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el fi qubattoonni lafa irraa, naannoo Qilleensaa (West Bank) keessatti haleellaa walitti aansuun raawwataniin namoonni Falasxiin 19 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kunneen reebicha qubattootaan raawwatamu, gaasii imimmaan fiduu fi dhukaasa waraanaan baname kan dabalatu dha. Qubattoonni naannicha keessatti babal'achuun isaanii maatiiwwan naannichaa irraa buqqa'uu fi sodaachifamuuf saaxilaa jira.

title: US Postal Service shares mail-in ballot restrictions despite court ruling
english: The U.S. Postal Service has released proposed rules that would restrict mail-in ballots by requiring states to share voter records and redesign ballot envelopes. Although these rules are currently blocked by court orders, the agency finalized them so they can be implemented quickly if the legal challenges are overturned. Critics argue these changes give the Trump administration improper control over state-run elections and could lead to the rejection of ballots in non-compliant states.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፖስታ አገልግሎት በፖስታ የሚላኩ የድምጽ መስጫ ወረቀቶች ላይ ገደቦችን የሚያስቀምጥ አዲስ መመሪያ ይፋ አድርጓል። ይህ መመሪያ ግዛቶች የመራጮችን መረጃ ለፖስታ ቤቱ እንዲያጋሩ እና የድምጽ መስጫ ወረቀት ፖስታዎችን እንዲቀይሩ ያስገድዳል። ምንም እንኳን ሕጉ በፍርድ ቤት የታገደ ቢሆንም፣ የፖስታ ቤቱ መሥሪያ ቤት የታገደው እገዳ ከተነሳ በፍጥነት ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ ዝግጅቱን አጠናቋል። ተቺዎች ይህ አካሄድ የፌዴራል መንግሥት በግዛቶች ምርጫ ላይ ጣልቃ እንዲገባ እና ድምጾች እንዲሰረዙ ሊያደርግ ይችላል ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Tajaajilli Poostaa Ameerikaa (USPS) sagalee poostaan eramu irratti daangaa haaraa kaa'uuf qophii xumureera. Dambii kana jalatti, naannooleen odeeffannoo filattootaa gadi baasuu fi saanduqa sagalee qaban jijjiiruun isaan irraa eegama. Murtii kanaan dura mana murtii irra darbe jiraatus, USPS dambicha qophii godhee kaa'eera; kunis murtichi yoo ka'e battaluma sanatti hojiirra oolchuuf kan gargaaruudha. Komattoonni ammoo, tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan federaalaa filannoo naannoolee to'achuuf akka itti fayyadamu fi sagaleen akka haalamu sodaachisa jedhu.

title: Iran grants permission for some Iraqi oil tankers to pass through Hormuz
english: Iran has allowed specific Iraqi oil tankers to transit through the Strait of Hormuz following diplomatic discussions between the two nations. This move follows Baghdad's assurances that Iraqi territory will not be used for military aggression against any neighboring countries. Experts suggest this decision reflects Iran's preference to support Iraq while pressuring other regional states to limit U.S. military access.
amharic: ኢራን ከኢራቅ መንግስት ጋር ባደረገችው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት ተከትሎ፣ የተወሰኑ የኢራቅ የነዳጅ መርከቦች በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ በኩል እንዲያልፉ ፈቅዳለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ባግዳድ የኢራቅ መሬት በጎረቤት ሀገራት ላይ ለሚፈጸም ጥቃት እንደማይውል ቃል ከገባች በኋላ ነው። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ ኢራን ይህን እርምጃ የወሰደችው ኢራቅን እንደ ወዳጅ ሀገር በመመልከት እና ሌሎች የባህረ ሰላጤ ሀገራት የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ እንዲገድቡ ጫና ለመፍጠር ነው።
oromo: Iraan marii dipiloomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti gaggeeffameen booda, dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraaq muraasni daandii galaana Hormuz akka qaxxaamuran hayyamteetti. Murtoon kun kan dhume, mootummaan Baagdaad lafti Iraaq biyyoota ollaa irratti miidhaa geessisuuf akka hin gargaarre waadaa erga galtee booda dha. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, Iraan tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte Iraaqiin akka biyya michuutti ilaaluu fi biyyoota naannichaa kanneen buufata waraanaa Ameerikaaf hayyamanii jiran irratti dhiibbaa gochuufi.

title: Why is Israel building new illegal settlements?
english: The Israeli government is accelerating the construction of illegal housing units in the occupied West Bank to strengthen its territorial control. By expanding these settlements, officials aim to prevent the formation of a unified Palestinian state. Despite facing widespread international condemnation and threats of potential sanctions, the administration continues to move forward with its development plans.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ህገ-ወጥ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን ግንባታ በማፋጠን ላይ ይገኛል። እነዚህን ሰፈሮች በማስፋፋት እስራኤል በግዛቱ ላይ ያላትን ቁጥጥር በማጠናከር አንድ ወጥ የሆነ የፍልስጤም መንግስት እንዳይመሰረት ለማድረግ እየሰራች ነው። ይህ አካሄድ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞዎች እና የማዕቀብ ማስፈራሪያዎች ቢገጥሙትም መንግስት ግን ግንባታውን ለማስቀጠል ቆርጧል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el to'annoo isaa naannoo Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa (West Bank) cimsachuuf jecha mana jireenyaa seeraan alaa ta'an ijaaruu ariifachiiseera. Ijaarsa kana babal'isuun, mootummaan Israa'el biyya Falasxiin tokko taate akka hin uumamne gufuu ta'uuf yaada. Ta'us, ijaarsi kun mormii idil-addunyaa fi xiyyeeffannoo maallaqaa (sanctions) kan kaase yoo ta'u, mootummaan Israa'el garuu karoora isaa itti fufuuf murteesseera.

title: More than 200,000 newly displaced in Sudan’s Kordofan region
english: The United Nations reports that ongoing conflict in Sudan’s Kordofan region has forced over 200,000 people to flee their homes since the end of last year. This violence is part of a broader civil war that began in 2023, which has already caused approximately 59,000 deaths. In total, the war has displaced 14 million people across the country, creating a massive humanitarian crisis.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው በሱዳን ኮርዶፋን አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ባለፈው ዓመት መጨረሻ አንስቶ ከ200,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጓል። እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 የተቀሰቀሰው ይህ ጦርነት እስካሁን 59,000 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን በአጠቃላይ 14 ሚሊዮን ዜጎችን ከመኖሪያቸው አፈናቅሏል። ይህም አገሪቱን ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ውስጥ እንድትገባ አድርጓታል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, gartuun waraanaa naannoo Kordofaanii keessatti dhalate irraa eegalee namoota 200,000 ol ta’an qe’ee isaanii irraa buqqiseera. Waraanni bara 2023 ka’e kun hanga ammaatti lubbuu namoota 59,000 ol kan galaafate yoo ta’u, waliigalatti namoota miiliyoon 14 ta’an mana isaanii irraa godaansiseera. Kunis biyyattii keessatti rakkoo namoomaa cimaa uumeera.

title: Israeli strikes kill two and injure others as Gaza attacks continue
english: Israeli military forces have intensified attacks across Gaza, resulting in the deaths of at least two Palestinians and multiple injuries over the last two days. Drone strikes and shelling in Deir el-Balah and Khan Younis have destroyed homes and damaged areas housing displaced families. Rescue teams continue to struggle with reaching victims as military operations and property demolitions persist in various parts of the territory.
amharic: ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት በእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። በዴር አል-ባላህ እና በካን ዩኒስ የተካሄዱ የድሮን ጥቃቶች እና የመድፍ ተኩስ ቤቶችን በማውደም ለተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ የሆኑ ቦታዎችን ክፉኛ ጎድተዋል። ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች እና የህንፃዎች መፍረስ በተለያዩ የጋዛ ክፍሎች እየቀጠለ በመሆኑ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ለተጎጂዎች ለመድረስ እየተቸገሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Guyyoota lamaan darban keessa humnoonni Israa'el gaazaatti haleellaa geggeessaniin namoonni lama ajjeefamanii kan biroo hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa waraanaatiin magaalaawwan Deir el-Balah fi Khan Younis keessatti manni jireenyaa fi bakkeen namoonni buqqa'an keessa jiraatan miidhamaniiru. Hojiin waraanaa fi diiggiin manneenii bakka gara garaatti itti fufee waan jiruuf, gareen gargaarsaa namoota miidhaman bira gahuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: Putin warns Ukraine has opened ‘Pandora’s box’, rejects peace proposals
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin has dismissed recent peace initiatives as unreasonable and unacceptable. He warned that Ukraine has invited severe consequences by attacking Russia’s financial systems. Furthermore, Putin signaled that Russia may retaliate by targeting Ukraine’s most critical economic sectors.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን የቀረቡትን የሰላም ሃሳቦች ተቀባይነት እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ኢኮኖሚ በማጥቃት ለከባድ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ የሚያጋልጥ መንገድ ከፍታለች ሲሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በተጨማሪም ፑቲን የዩክሬንን ቁልፍ የኢኮኖሚ ዘርፎች ኢላማ በማድረግ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Raashiyaa Vlaadimir Puutin yaada nageenyaa dhihaate fudhatama kan hin qabne jechuun didaniiru. Yukireeniin dinagdee Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuun ishee miidhaa cimaaf akka ishee saaxiltu akeekkachiisaniiru. Kana malees, Puutin Raashiyaan dinagdee Yukireen kanatti aanee jiru kan miidhu tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka dandeessu ibsaniiru.

title: Envoy says Israel did not give the US notice before strikes on Syrian base
english: US special envoy Tom Barrack recently accused Israel of launching military strikes on a Syrian base without providing prior warning to the United States. Israeli officials have rejected this claim, insisting that they shared relevant intelligence with American authorities before the operation took place. The incident highlights rising tensions, as Barrack criticized the move as an unnecessary escalation that could provoke Turkey, while Israel continues to assert its regional security interests.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ቶም ባራክ እስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ከመሰንዘሯ በፊት ለአሜሪካ ምንም አይነት ማስጠንቀቂያ እንዳልሰጠች ገልጸዋል። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ግን ይህንን ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ በፊት አስፈላጊውን መረጃ ለአሜሪካ አካላት ማድረሳቸውን አጥብቀው ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት ያሳየ ሲሆን፣ ባራክ ጥቃቱን ለቱርክ የሚያስቆጣ እና አላስፈላጊ ውጥረት የሚፈጥር ተግባር ነው ሲሉ ነቅፈዋል።
oromo: Ergamaan addaa Ameerikaa Tom Barrack akka jedhutti, Israa'el buufata waraanaa Suuriyaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf Ameerikaaf dursitee akeekkachiisa hin kennine. Bakka bu'oonni Israa'el himata kana gadi dhisuun, haleellicha dura odeeffannoo barbaachisaa ta'e qaamolee Ameerikaaf qoodneerra jechuun falman. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa dabalaa jiru kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, Barrack haleellaa kana Turkii kan aarsuu fi waldhibdee kan babal'isu tarkaanfii barbaachisaa hin taane jechuun balaaleffateera.

title: Canada to match US tariffs “dollar for dollar,” PM Carney says
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced that Canada will respond to new American tariffs by imposing equivalent duties on U.S. goods. This decision follows the collapse of trade negotiations between the two neighboring nations. The move signals a firm retaliatory stance in response to the U.S. trade policies.
amharic: የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ እንደተናገሩት ካናዳ በአሜሪካ ላይ በምትጥለው አዲስ የታሪፍ ጫና ልክ የአጸፋ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ አቅዳለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተካሄደው የንግድ ድርድር ሳይሳካ በመቅረቱ ነው። ካናዳ በአሜሪካ የንግድ ፖሊሲ ላይ እኩል የሆነ የበቀል እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ዝግጁ መሆኗን ይህ ድርጊት ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii akka ibsanitti, Kaanaadaan taarifii Ameerikaan ishee irratti buufteef deebii walfakkaataa kennuuf akka murteessite beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufeyyuu erga mariin daldalaa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti ture fashale booda. Tarkaanfiin kun siyaasa daldalaa Ameerikaatiif deebii cimaa kennuu akka barbaadan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Carney: Canada will enact retaliatory US tariffs starting September 8
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced that Canada will impose retaliatory tariffs on American goods beginning September 8. This decision follows the United States' recent move to place a 50 percent tax on nearly $20 billion worth of Canadian imports. Although both nations attempted to reach a trade agreement to prevent this, negotiations failed, leading Canada to take these measures to defend its economy.
amharic: የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ እንደገለጹት፣ ካናዳ ከሴፕቴምበር 8 ጀምሮ በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ የበቀል የንግድ ታሪፍ እንደምትጥል አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው አሜሪካ በ20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመቱ የካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የ50 በመቶ ታሪፍ መጣሏን ተከትሎ ነው። ሁለቱ አገራት የንግድ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ቢሞክሩም፣ ድርድሩ ባለመሳካቱ ካናዳ ኢኮኖሚዋን ለመጠበቅ ይህን እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ተገዳለች።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii akka ibsanitti, Kaanaadaan eegalee Hagayya 8 irraa kaasee meeshaalee Ameerikaa irraa galan irratti gatii dabalataa (taarifa) akka keettu beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufey Ameerikaan meeshaalee Kaanaadaa kan gatiin isaanii dolaara biliyoona 20 ga'u irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 erga keessee booda. Biyoonni lamaan waliigaltee daldalaa uumanii rakkoo kana hambisuuf yaalii godhanis, mariin isaanii waan hin milkoofneef, Kaanaadaan diinagdee ishee eeggachuuf tarkaanfii kana fudhachuu dirqamteetti.

title: Israel, Turkiye and the new regional reordering
english: Israeli fighter jets recently bombed a Syrian airbase under the false pretext of Turkish military activity, an action that drew widespread international condemnation. US intelligence officials confirmed they found no evidence for Israel’s claims, suggesting the strike was a politically motivated attempt by Benjamin Netanyahu to escalate regional tensions before his election. Turkey chose not to retaliate, instead urging the United States to take a more active role in curbing Israel’s aggressive actions.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በቱርክ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት በሚል ሰበብ በሶሪያ የሚገኝ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። የአሜሪካ የስለላ ተቋማት በእስራኤል በኩል የቀረበው የይገባኛል ጥያቄ መሠረተ ቢስ መሆኑን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ ጥቃቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ለምርጫ ዘመቻቸው ሲሉ የፈጠሩት የፖለቲካ ቀውስ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ቱርክ ለዚህ ግጭት ወታደራዊ ምላሽ ከመስጠት ይልቅ አሜሪካ በእስራኤል ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንድታሳድር ጥሪ አቅርባለች።
oromo: Xiyyaarri waraana Israa’el sababa sobaan gocha waraana Turkii jechuun buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaa keessatti argamu haleeluun isaa mormii idil-addunyaa guddaa kaaseera. Qorannoon ogeeyyota basaasaa Ameerikaa akka agarsiisutti, himatni Israa’el dhugaa kan hin qabne ta’uu fi haleellaan kun mummicha ministeeraa Beniyaamin Neetaanyaahuuf faayidaa filannoo argamsiisuuf kan karoorfame ta’uu ibsameera. Turkii tarkaanfii waraanaatiin deebisuu mannaa, Ameerikaan gocha Israa’el kanneen to’achuuf qooda akka fudhatu gaafatteetti.

title: Swedish police identify 17-year-old girl as victim in school sword attack
english: Swedish authorities have confirmed that a 17-year-old girl was killed in a sword attack at a high school in Fagersta. An 18-year-old student at the same school has been arrested for the killing and the wounding of three other students. Investigators are currently examining whether the suspect was influenced by online extremist groups that glorify school violence.
amharic: የስዊድን ባለስልጣናት በፋገርስታ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጸመ የሰይፍ ጥቃት የ17 ዓመቷ ሴት ልጅ መገደሏን አረጋግጠዋል። በተመሳሳይ ትምህርት ቤት የሚማር የ18 ዓመት ተማሪ ግድያውን በመፈጸም እና ሌሎች ሶስት ተማሪዎችን በማቁሰል ተጠርጥሮ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። መርማሪዎች ተጠርጣሪው በትምህርት ቤት ውስጥ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶችን የሚያበረታቱ የኢንተርኔት ቡድኖች ተጽዕኖ ውስጥ ገብቶ እንደሆነ እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Siwiiden akka mirkaneessanitti, magaalaa Faagireestaatti mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa tokko keessatti weerara billaatiin dargaggeettiin umriin ishee waggaa 17 ta'e ajjeefamtee jirti. Barataan umriin isaa waggaa 18 mana barumsaa sanaa ta'e tokko ajjeechaa kana raawwachuu fi barattoota biroo sadii madaa'anirratti shakkamee qabameera. Qorattoonni weerarri kun qindoomina gareewwan interneetii kanneen jeequmsa mana barumsaa jajjabeessanirratti kan hirkate ta'uu isaa qorachaa jiru.

title: Israel has no intention of escalating tensions with Turkey, foreign minister says
english: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar stated that his country does not want to increase tensions with Turkey, but firmly opposes any Turkish military presence in Syria. Israel is concerned that such a presence could mirror the regional influence of Iran and has justified recent airstrikes by citing intelligence about potential Turkish base construction. While both Syria and Turkey have denied these claims, Israel remains committed to preventing new military developments in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ጊዲዮን ሳር ሀገራቸው ከቱርክ ጋር ያለውን ውጥረት ለማባባስ እንደማትፈልግ ነገር ግን በሶሪያ ውስጥ የቱርክን ወታደራዊ መገኘት እንደማትቀበል አስታውቀዋል። እስራኤል የቱርክ መገኘት እንደ ኢራን ተጽዕኖ ሊፈጥር ይችላል በሚል ስጋት፣ በሶሪያ ላይ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ፈጽማለች። ምንም እንኳን ሶሪያ እና ቱርክ በሶሪያ ውስጥ ቋሚ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ የመመሥረት እቅድ እንደሌላቸው ቢክዱም፣ እስራኤል በክልሉ አዲስ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችን ለመከላከል ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Israa'el Gidiyon Saar akka jedhanitti, biyyi isaanii Turkiin wajjin walitti bu'iinsa dabaluu kan hin barbaanne ta'us, buufata waraanaa Turkiin gara fuulduraatti Siiriyaa keessatti ijaaruu akka hin hayyamne ibsaniiru. Israa'el, dhiibbaan Turkiin Siiriyaa keessatti uumuu dandeessu kan Iiraan fakkaachuu danda'a sodaatti, kanaafis oduu buufata waraanaa ijaaruu irratti hundaa'uun miidhaa qilleensaa geessisteetti. Siiriyaafi Turkiin ijaarsa buufata waraanaa kanarratti haaluus, Israa'el naannichatti haala waraanaa jijjiiramu kamiyyuu akka hin hayyamne beeksisteetti.

title: US 'economic terrorism' will not break people's will: Iranian Vice President
english: Iranian First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref recently stated that US sanctions will not succeed in destabilizing his country. He argued that economic pressure actually strengthens the resolve of the Iranian people rather than weakening it. This reaction follows President Trump's decision to impose strict new financial penalties against Tehran.
amharic: የኢራን አንደኛ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ሞሀመድ ረዛ አሬፍ የአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች ሀገራቸውን እንደማያዳክሙ ገለጹ። እንደ እርሳቸው ገለጻ፣ የኢኮኖሚ ጫናዎች የኢራን ህዝብን ከመጉዳት ይልቅ ይበልጥ እንዲጠነክሩ ያደርጋቸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቴህራን ላይ አዲስ እና ከባድ ማዕቀቦችን መጣላቸውን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidaantii Iraan Mohaammad Rezaa Aaref akka jedhanitti, sagantaan uggura dinagdee kan Ameerikaa biyya isaanii hin laaffisu. Akka isaanii, dhiibbaan dinagdee kun fedhii uummata Iraan dadhabsiisuu mannaa, caalaatti akka jabaatan taasisa. Ibsi kun kan kenname pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp Teheran irratti uggura dinagdee cimaa haaraa erga labsanii booda.

title: Israeli forces, settlers injure and arrest Palestinians across West Bank
english: Israeli forces and settlers conducted several violent operations throughout the West Bank, resulting in multiple injuries and arrests. Near Jerusalem and Jenin, five Palestinians were hospitalized following gunfire and physical attacks by settlers. Additionally, military forces entered a town near Hebron to raid homes and detain a young man.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በፈጸሙት ጥቃት በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል እንዲሁም ታስረዋል። በኢየሩሳሌም እና በጀኒን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸሙ የተኩስ እና የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃቶች አምስት ሰዎች ሆስፒታል ገብተዋል። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ወታደሮቹ በሄብሮን አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ከተማ በመግባት ቤቶችን በመበርበር አንድ ወጣት አሥረዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoonni iddoo gara garaa Qoqqoodama Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfii fudhataniin namoonni hedduun miidhaniiru akkasumas hidhamaniiru. Arraada Yerusaalem fi Jeniinitti dhukaasaa fi haleellaa qonnaan bultootaan namoonni shan hospitaala galeera. Kana malees, waraanni magaalaa Heebroon biratti argamtu tokko seenuudhaan manneen sakatta'anii dargaggeessa tokko hidhaniiru.

title: Blast on security forces’ bus near Damascus causes injuries
english: A bomb exploded on a vehicle transporting Syrian security personnel near Damascus on Saturday, resulting in multiple injuries. State media reported that officials are currently examining the scene to determine who was behind the attack. Images released from the site show significant damage to the bus, including shattered glass and a destroyed door.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በሶሪያዋ ዳማስከስ አቅራቢያ የጸጥታ ኃይሎችን ሲያጓጉዝ በነበረ አውቶቡስ ላይ በደረሰ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ በርካታ ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱን ማን እንደፈጸመ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። ከቦታው የወጡ ምስሎች እንደሚያሳዩት አውቶቡሱ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa guddoo Suuriyaa Damaasqoos biratti konkolaataa waraana fe'ee deemaa ture irratti boombii dhoo'een namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Miidiyaan mootummaa akka gabaasetti, qaamni nageenyaa haleellaa kana eenyu akka raawwate adda baasuuf qorannoo eegaleera. Suuraan iddoo sanaa akka argisiisutti, konkolaataan sun gubatee fi cabee miidhaa hamaa irra ga'ee jira.

title: Armed men kidnap dozens in attacks on Nigerian villages
english: Armed assailants launched a series of attacks on multiple villages and a mosque in Nigeria's Niger State, resulting in the abduction of dozens of people. While authorities are currently conducting rescue operations, there are conflicting reports from residents regarding potential casualties and the exact number of individuals taken. The violence reportedly involved clashes between two armed groups, leaving local communities in a state of crisis.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ ናይጀር ግዛት የታጠቁ ቡድኖች በበርካታ መንደሮች እና በመስጊድ ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ጠልፈዋል። ባለስልጣናት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እያከናወኑ ቢሆንም፣ በሟቾች ቁጥር እና በተጠለፉት ሰዎች ትክክለኛ መጠን ላይ ከነዋሪዎች የሚሰሙት መረጃዎች የተለያዩ ናቸው። ግጭቱ በሁለት የታጠቁ ቡድኖች መካከል የተከሰተ ሲሆን ይህም በአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Naijeeriyaa keessatti gareen hidhattootaa gandoota fi masjiida tokko irratti haleellaa raawwatanin namoota hedduu butanii jiru. Mootummaan hojii furinsaatii fi ittisaa kan eegale yoo ta'u, lakkoofsa namoota butamanii fi miidhaa ga'e irratti odeeffannoon wal faallessu jira. Walitti bu'iinsi kun gidduu garee hidhattoota lamaa kan uumame yoo ta'u, ummanni naannichaa sodaa keessa akka jiraatu ta'eera.

title: Israel’s Chief Rabbi says Palestinians are not a people and have no rights
english: Israel's Chief Rabbi David Yosef has sparked controversy by claiming that Palestinians do not exist as a distinct people and possess no inherent rights. Speaking at a museum event, he further advocated for the destruction of Gaza and the establishment of Jewish settlements across both Gaza and the occupied West Bank. These remarks represent a hardline stance that asserts exclusive Jewish territorial claims over these disputed regions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ዋና ረቢ ዳዊት ዮሴፍ ፍልስጤማውያን እንደ ህዝብ እንደማይቆጠሩ እና ምንም አይነት መብት እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ ከፍተኛ ትችት አስነስተዋል። በሙዚየም በተከናወነ ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ባደረጉት ንግግር፣ ጋዛ መውደም እንዳለባት እና አይሁዳውያን በጋዛና በዌስት ባንክ ሰፈራ ሊመሰርቱ እንደሚገባ ተናግረዋል። ይህ አቋም በእነዚህ አካባቢዎች ላይ የእስራኤልን የበላይነት የሚደግፍና የፍልስጤማውያንን መብት የሚክድ ነው።
oromo: Rabbiin Olaanaa Israa'el Daawit Yoseef, warra Falasxiin akka sabaatti hin jiran jedhee fi mirga tokkollee akka hin qabne dubbachuun isaa mormii guddaa kaaseera. Ayyaana muuziyemii tokko irratti yeroo dubbatu, Gaazaarratti tarkaanfiin diiggaa akka fudhatamuufi lafa Gaazaafi Lixaa Baankii keessatti qubatanii jiraachuu akka qaban gaafateera. Haasaan kun laficharratti mirgi kan warra Yihuudii qofa akka ta'e kan ibsuufi mirga Falasxiinotaa kan guutummaatti tuffateedha.

title: Trump seeks to block the BBC’s attempt to subpoena Ivanka Trump, Trump Jr
english: President Donald Trump is asking a federal court to prevent the BBC from questioning his family members, including Ivanka Trump, Donald Trump Jr., and Jared Kushner. The subpoenas were requested by the BBC as part of a $10 billion defamation lawsuit filed by Trump over a documentary that allegedly edited his January 6th speech. Trump’s lawyers argue that the broadcaster is using the legal process to conduct an intrusive investigation rather than focusing on the specific editing dispute.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የቢቢሲ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ የቤተሰባቸውን አባላት፣ ኢቫንካ ትራምፕን፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጁኒየርን እና ጃሬድ ኩሽነርን እንዳይጠይቁ ለፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት አቤቱታ አቅርበዋል። ቢቢሲ እነዚህን ሰዎች ለመጥራት የፈለገው ትራምፕ በዶክመንተሪ ፕሮግራም ላይ ባቀረቡት የ10 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የክብር መነካካት ክስ ምክንያት ነው። የትራምፕ ጠበቆች ቢቢሲው ክሱን ሰበብ በማድረግ ፍትህን ከመፈለግ ይልቅ ቤተሰባቸውን ለማሸማቀቅ እየሞከረ ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Dooktar Doonaald Tiraamp, dhaabbanni miidiyaa BBC miseensota maatii isaa kanneen akka Ivaanka Tiraamp, Doonaald Tiraamp Juniyeer fi Jaared Kushnar akka hin gaafanneef mana murtii federaalaatti iyyatanii jiru. BBC'n namoota kana kan barbaade, Tiraamp sagantaa dookumentarii irratti miidhameera jechuun himata gatii biliyoona 10 irratti dhiyeesse hordofuudha. Abukaatonni Tiraamp, dhaabbanni miidiyaa kun himata dhihaate fayyadamee maatii isaa irratti qorannoo hin barbaachisne gaggeessuuf yaalaa jira jechuun himatu.
